headline: International Friendship Protocol Team Forced To Overtime After Italy’s Prime Minister Sends Unscheduled Birthday Greeting
body:
The Ministry of External Affairs’ dedicated ‘International Greetings and Pleasantries Division’ was plunged into a state of total administrative chaos this morning after receiving an unscripted birthday wish from the Italian Prime Minister to the Indian Prime Minister. Staffers were reportedly seen scrambling to locate the official 400-page manual on ‘Diplomatic Birthday Response Latency,’ which stipulates that any well-wishes from a G7 leader must be met with a reciprocal acknowledgement issued exactly 47 minutes after the initial tweet.

“We had planned the entire day around a scheduled release of a generic commemorative postage stamp,” said Senior Protocol Officer Ravi Shastry, who was spotted drinking his fifth cup of lukewarm cutting chai at 11:00 AM. “When the notification popped up, we had to divert three junior clerks away from filing our quarterly ‘High-Five Audit’ to draft a response that conveys sufficient warmth without accidentally triggering a new free-trade agreement. We are currently debating whether a folded-hands emoji is too casual or if it suggests a desire for an immediate bilateral summit.”

By midday, the department had converted the main conference room into a ‘War Room for Sentiment Analysis,’ where team members were busy verifying if the words ‘energy’ and ‘success’ contained any hidden subtext related to pending textile tariffs. The division is expected to remain operational until midnight, as they must now wait for the exact moment of the Prime Minister’s actual birthday to hit ‘send’ on the pre-approved, legally vetted, and grammatically flawless response.
caption: Diplomacy is hard work, especially when the birthday wishes arrive before the official response schedule is finalized. Sending good vibes only, provided they fit the G7 protocol. (satire) #Diplomacy #BirthdayGreetings #Protocol #Tafri
